summary: Charlton Aria Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq (CHARU/CHAR/CHARR), filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing an October 6 Business Combination Agreement with KQC Quantum, Inc., Merger Sub KQC MS Limited, and Korea Quantum Computing Co., Ltd. KQC Korea shareholders first transferred 100% of shares to Parent in a Reorganization. A pre-closing recapitalization sets the Reference Price framework, with Equity Value divided by Fully Diluted Parent Stock. No price per share or premium was stated. Watch shareholder redemption levels, earnout-share dilution, and the de-SPAC regulatory and Nasdaq listing clock.
